learning_application: Preservation contracts must distinguish protected creative decisions from defective realization. Exact terrain preservation contradicted requested correction.
Inspect source material assignments before blanket replacement; eye/mouth/hoof regions are semantic anatomy, not optional polish.
A whole-action timing comparison is required; naming each motion phase is not evidence it matches the reference.
Traction launch needs one travel-wheel-yaw-camera contract; isolated wheelspin and sideways offsets cannot establish acceleration causality.
World-space ownership is necessary but insufficient for dust; optical mass and persistence at the final camera are part of the test.
